prompts.silla:
Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Create a production transparent PNG sprite atlas of EXACTLY FIVE female chibi moe comic Korean historical officer BUST PORTRAITS. Reference image 1 provides these five identities in reading order; reference image 2 is the required newly approved paint/line/SD portrait style. Redraw the five with the STYLE of reference 2: warm brown crisp hand-drawn contours, polished textured anime shading, expressive chibi faces, rich Korean historical garments. Preserve reference 1 individual hair colour, hairstyle and main ornaments, but REMOVE ALL EYEGLASSES COMPLETELY from every person. No frames, lenses or glasses temples anywhere, show clean unobstructed eyes. Make face shapes/eye shapes/brows/expressions visibly distinct. Include entire hair, ornaments, BOTH FULL SHOULDERS and upper chest/armor to below collarbone. Do not just draw necks. All have feminine adult character designs, same chibi proportions as style reference.
Layout: landscape 3 columns x 2 rows, first row3 portraits, second row2 portraits in left and middle, bottom right EMPTY. Each portrait isolated with very WIDE transparent gaps and generous transparent outer margins. Each portrait occupies at most 68% of its own cell width and 70% cell height. Center every bust within its cell. No hair or shoulders crossing into another cell. No body parts touching canvas edges. REAL alpha transparent background with zero painted backdrop; no solid rectangles, glow, shadow, gradients, pattern or circular backing. NO TEXT, no numbers, no labels. No hands, weapons, full bodies or new people.
Silla yellow/gold identity. Reading order:
1 김정술 archer: dark chestnut tall half-up braided bun with long loose sides and small golden flower, composed long oval face and narrow alert amber eyes, understated closed smile, cream archer jacket with asymmetric small gold shoulder guard and yellow neck trim.
2 박월령 light cavalry scout: silvery short tousled bob with one small side braid and golden headband, cheeky angular heart face, laughing open grin and raised brow, yellow wrapped scarf and brown leather cavalry shoulder pieces.
3 석도겸 strategist: auburn braided low side bun, yellow braid ribbon, REMOVE ROUND GLASSES from original; long slim thoughtful face, clear narrower amber eyes, inquisitive one raised brow, ivory scholar robe with golden embroidered collar, no bulky armor.
4 김무찬 infantry protector: brown wavy twin buns, broad round plump face, big beaming toothy smile, thicker brows, warm fur collar and heavy golden lamellar shoulders.
5 아랑 light cavalry challenger: dark burgundy brown high ponytail with gold forehead band, compact square athletic face and determined sideways challenging smirk, gold plate shoulder guard with yellow strap and practical ochre riding jacket.
